title: Optimize Console: Safe-Apply Sandbox, Diff Replay, and Forensic Apply History
creator: Aisha Khan
description: Add a safe, inspectable workflow in the Optimize tab that lets engineers preview batching and caching recommendations, run a dry-run in a sandbox environment, apply configuration diffs with an explicit transaction and rollback path, and surface a searchable audit trail. The feature should make cost recommendations actionable while minimizing risk to production inference latency and correctness.
acceptance_criteria: Recommendation cards render cost delta, estimated latency impact, and a confidence score; clicking a card opens a side panel with a diff preview highlighting changed fields.

Users can run a dry-run (sandbox) that simulates the effect of the config change for a selected route/model without changing production routing or autoscaling; dry-run results show token-level cost estimates and a per-route latency histogram based on historical traffic samples.
Apply flow creates an immutable transaction ID, writes a human-readable diff to the apply history, and records the operator, timestamp, and associated PR/Run ID.
Rollback action can be executed from the apply history; rollback is auditable and creates a new transaction entry with a link to the original apply.
Audit trail supports filters by actor, transaction ID, model, route, and date range and supports CSV export for compliance reviews.
RBAC: only users with 'Optimize:Apply' role can promote sandboxed diffs to production; viewers can see recommendations and run dry-runs.
End-to-end tests exist for UI flows: open card -> diff preview -> dry-run -> apply -> rollback -> audit entry appears.
Performance: opening a diff preview must return within 500ms for 95% of cases under normal metadata load.
engineering_notes: Backend requires a new 'staged_config' entity with transaction_id, created_by, created_at, status(enum: sandbox|applied|rolled_back).
We will implement diff previews by storing normalized config trees and rendering unified diffs; heavy diffs should stream in the UI to avoid blocking large models metadata fetches.

Dry-run will be implemented by wiring a read-only evaluation runner that replays a sampled request set against the candidate config in a sandbox namespace; this needs workload sampling jobs (ENG-2298).
Consider using event-sourcing for apply/rollback events to make the audit trail append-only and easier to export; retention policy must be configurable per-org.
Security: ensure KMS keys are not exported in diffs; mask secrets and key identifiers in UI (DES-344).
rollout_plan: Phase 1 (beta): internal-only for Platform and SRE teams; enable dry-run and local apply to staging namespaces.
Phase 2: opt-in rollout to paid customers by feature flag; enable apply to production for early enterprise customers.
Phase 3: general availability with 90-day audit retention and CSV export in Enterprise tier.
Fallback: if dry-run sampling is identified as biased, disable auto-suggest apply and switch to manual review only.
qa_checklist: UI: card list pagination, card sorting by savings, confidence and recency.
Security: confirm secrets masked in diffs and in audit logs.
E2E: simulate a full apply + rollback on staging and verify traffic route consistency.
Load: diff preview under heavy org metadata (1k models) should remain responsive.
Compliance: CSV export schema validated against legal team sample.

release_notes_blurb: Optimize Console: preview and safely apply batching/caching recommendations via a sandboxed dry-run and auditable apply history. Enterprise: CSV export + configurable retention.
notes_for_support: Support should ask for transaction_id (visible on the apply confirmation) when triaging a customer rollback request.
If a customer reports mismatched dry-run vs production results, request sampling job ID and provide logs from the dry-run runner.
